content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a complete combination of free and paid tools that enable digital creators to set up a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This matters because it allows creators to maintain control over their sales process and customer data, without having to rely on third-party platforms that may charge high fees or have restrictive policies.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack typically consists of a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage platform like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a payment processing platform like NOWPayments. These components work together to enable creators to sell their digital products for crypto, with automatic payment verification and instant product delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who are restricted from using platforms like Stripe and PayPal, or who want to maintain control over their sales process and customer data. It is particularly useful for creators who sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and Notion templates, and who want to reach a global audience without being limited by platform restrictions.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks enable creators to sell digital products for crypto without platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and setting up their online store. They can then integrate a backend logic platform and an order storage platform, and finally connect a payment processing platform like NOWPayments. With the right components in place, creators can start selling their digital products for crypto and reaching a global audience without platform restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with a payment processing platform like NOWPayments, which charges a 0.5% fee on every sale. This allows creators to maintain control over their sales process and customer data, while also reaching a global audience without platform restrictions.
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on every sale, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

For creators who want to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to get started. This kit includes everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, and can be purchased at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up their online store, integrate a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, connect an order storage platform like Supabase or Google Sheets, and finally integrate a payment processing platform like NOWPayments. By following these steps, creators can start selling their digital products for crypto and reaching a global audience without platform restrictions.
